assignments.essential_function: Prepare offer-letter text, compensation summary and manager negotiation notes from actual hiring details.

review: Reclassified as selected unchanged for offer preparation within the broader Recruiter role. Native workflow gathers role, level, location, compensation, dates and manager; drafts the offer and negotiation notes; optionally reads compensation/headcount from HRIS and updates ATS offer status. It is a generic draft template, not a jurisdiction-complete employment agreement; the source includes full-time/exempt and dollar-denominated example fields. Company-specific terms and local legal review remain normal use inputs/review, not a proposed content patch.
native_prerequisites: Actual compensation, employment classification, benefits, start date and manager from the company
human-resources/CONNECTORS.md; optional HRIS for bands/headcount and optional ATS for candidate/status
If ATS is connected, its native workflow may update offer status; connector permissions must be supported
